findings.reason: The design lets a disconnected holder act on a superseded mute setting, although the credential-locality exception covers the push key and the Conversations Pending exception requires durable receipt states and catch-up before serving a current view.
The opening relies on an unexplained Chief handoff, server card and frozen parent PR before telling a reader what a delayed reply notification does today and what mute and archive will change.

fit.reason: Plain-language confirmations help readers understand what was saved and whether notifications may still arrive, but the core design governs server-side preferences and push delivery while the app owner controls action placement, visual hierarchy, and phone usability.
